title: VIC accident towing base fee (first 8 km, under 4 t GVM, controlled areas), incl GST

scope.classification: Base fee for towing, inclusive of the first 8 kms travelled; motor vehicles under 4.0 tonnes GVM; controlled areas

qualifications.text: This notice comes into operation on 1 July 2026.
All varied charge amounts in this notice are inclusive of GST.
7. Fee per km travelled by tow truck beyond the first 8 kms […] resulting in a varied charge amount of $4.60.
8. After hours surcharge […] resulting in a varied charge amount of $98.80.

evidence.publisher: Victoria Government Gazette (Secretary, Department of Transport and Planning)
evidence.title: Accident Towing Services Act 2007: Variation of charges for 2026–27 for accident towing and storage services under section 212H (Special Gazette No. S 257, 22 May 2026)
evidence.quote: 6. Base fee for towing inclusive of the first 8 kms travelled […] for the base fee for towing accident damaged motor vehicles with a gross vehicle mass of less than 4.0 tonnes from a road accident scene, within an area declared to be a controlled area […] resulting in a varied charge amount of $289.60.

locator.paragraph: 6. Base fee for towing inclusive of the first 8 kms travelled
